description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for entity tags, including a method to get cache size and an enum for default config values related to streaming cache size.

classes.name: TagsConfig
classes.description: Provides configuration settings for entity tags, including method for cache size.

classes.name: TagsConfig.TagsConfigValue
classes.description: Enumeration of known config path expressions and default values for TagsConfig.

methods.name: getStreamingCacheSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the cache used for streaming tags (each stream has its own cache).
